notes.title: New Visual Update 0.25.17
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

As we´ve developed the game, some parts fell behind visually; this update aims to bring these areas up to the standard of the rest of the game!

Patch Notes

Updates

 Reworked Water Material
 Updated Portal VFX
 General Visual Tweaks and Updates
 New Holidy themed hat


What´s Next?

We´re still working on adding more content to the game, as in the previously discussed team based mode and some features we´re not ready to announce yet. Mostly because we can´t give a timeline for how long things will take.

notes.title: New Content Patch 0.24.15: Storm Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Due to real-life issues and commitments, bringing you this update has taken longer than planned, but now it´s finally here. The update revolves around the stormy seas and includes a new map and power-up that embodies this theme. 

Patch Notes

Features

 New Map with new destructible objects and weather effects. Also, watch out for the TORNADOES! 
 New Tornado projectile that travels through walls and launches your foes in random directions.
 General optimisation and performance improvements. 


What´s Next?

We plan to introduce a team-based game mode for our next update and make general visual updates focused on lighting and the water. It should also be out sooner, as real life seems to have settled down. That being said, the fact that we´re just two people developing the game in our spare time still remains, so development can be unpredictable.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2369130/Slimes__Cannon_Combat/

notes.title: Early Access Launch!
notes.content:
It´s finally time; the game is now out in early access. Grab your friends or enemies alike and challenge them to a slime-to-slime duel. If you have any feedback or thoughts, feel free to share them on our Steam Community page. We´d love to hear from you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2369130/Slimes__Cannon_Combat/

What is currently included in early access?

 Online Multiplayer with up to 6 players.
 Three levels with a fully destructible environment 
 Nine different powerups that can be combined for ultimate mayhem.
 Character Customization in the form of unique Hats and Colors

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.18.10 - Keyboard and Mouse Support Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We´re happy to announce that our game now supports keyboard and mouse. The latest patch also brings a couple of quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes to the demo. You can find the full list of changes below.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2369130/Slimes__Cannon_Combat/

Features

 Keyboard and Mouse Support.

Changes

 UI have been reworked to support keyboard and mouse, and controller.
 Additional resolution options can be found under Settings.
 Increased the power of the Gatling Cannon, so Green Slime can actually win a round.
 Added additional particles for ground explosives and small projectile impact.


Fixes and Optimisation 

 Error messages should not correctly convey what went wrong, not that anything ever goes wrong with our game.
 Fixed an issue where the player would die twice.
 The ground should be less rebellious in gameplay and correctly appear and disappear.
 General Optimisation and Stability Updates, for better GPU performance.
